{"parentUuid":"375dedc7-1a28-468b-b63a-4374d2346f83","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"mcp_instructions_delta","addedNames":["plugin:context7:context7","plugin:serena:serena"],"addedBlocks":["## plugin:context7:context7\nUse this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service -- even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. This includes API syntax, configuration, version migration, library-specific debugging, setup instructions, and CLI tool usage. Use even when you think you know the answer -- your training data may not reflect recent changes. {"parentUuid":"271de7ff-321d-41c4-8ea4-fd396f70f074","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run (\"run this once at 3pm\", \"remind me to check X tomorrow\").\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- empirical-probe-first: Probe ALL viable strategies in a multi-option ladder BEFORE committing to one. Use when a session-plan / decision-ADR / spec presents ≥3 strategy options (e.g. \"Strategy A1/A2/A3\" or \"alternative B/C/D\") and the recommended option's source-evidence may be stale. Outputs a probe matrix per strategy + commit decision with empirical citation. Pairs with `vendor-api-probe.sh` (deterministic detection layer; SessionStart hook) and `decompose-work` (deterministic-vs-LLM split per probe). Charter promotion target — codifies L-S32-1 doctrine surfaced at S32 Track A pivot (master-plan recommended A2 vnstock alternate; empirical probe rejected A1+A2; A3 SSI direct httpx adopted instead).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- sync-pull: On-demand confidence-score lookup before a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision. Reads agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv + weights.yaml; surfaces the relevant category's score, tier, must-grill flag, and the decision-class threshold. Output drives \"self-decide vs grill\" choice. Use whenever an agent is about to commit a non-trivial decision and needs to ground confidence in historical hit rate per Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence).\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. {"parentUuid":"51327fab-2460-430b-a1c0-b1c6f46963a1","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"nested_memory","path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","content":{"path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\agent-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","type":"Project","content":"# agent-workspace/ — Contract\n\n> **Audience**: agents working inside `agent-workspace/`.\n> **Established**: Decision 002 § Track 1 (Workspace Dualism Foundation).\n\n## Identity\n\n`agent-workspace/` is the **agent-owned execution + memory** layer. Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). Every confidence claim cites historical hit rate (I-S20-equivalent).\n\n6. **Agents never `git commit` in this directory unless user explicitly requests.** Stage only.\n\n7. **`patterns-discovered/` artifacts are READ-ONLY for production code.** Patterns must be promoted to constitution / skills / hook scripts before becoming binding. (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. Highest-priority for this directory:)\n\n- **AP-1 Same-agent self-review** — never review your own implementation; dispatch fresh-context verifier\n- **AP-2 Self-track wind-down** — `.transcript-tokens` real-transcript is authoritative, not LLM self-track\n- **AP-5 Charter-coherence defer overriding user-CRITICAL** — re-read all `user_prompt/*` at every phase entry; never silently defer USER-CRITICAL\n- **AP-7 Performative SC ticking** — defer with explicit prerequisites > fire vacuous proposals\n- **AP-8 Pre-staged work causing checkpoint drift** — update `current-execution.md` immediately on task complete, not session-end\n- **AP-17 Identity drift** — stockforge is AI-first VN stock advisory; not generic financial framework (see `constitution/identity-scope.md` once Track 7 ships)\n- **AP-23 Continuous LLM-Guardian** — deterministic hooks = Guardian; LLM Guardian only at session-end aggregation\n\n---\n\n## Connection to human-workspace/\n\nThis directory is the agent's domain. Human's domain is `human-workspace/`. Multi-track-IMPL allowed only when tracks are mechanically independent (T2 + T6 are; T3 needs T2 done first).\n50\t2. **Every hook authored in this phase MUST ship with a companion firing-test** (T7 retrofit codifies this rule). Unit-test of script logic is NOT enough — empirical fire required.\n51\t3. **No silent re-attestation**. M-S171-1 prevention rule #3.\n# Pairs with phase-status-coherence.sh (same session; complementary check).\n#\n# Source-of-truth pattern markers (anchored from S148-S170 production blocks):\n#   ## S<N> — Phase <X> — ROUTINE-IDLE: ...\n#   ## S<N> — Phase <X> — META-CADENCE: ...\n# Both are zero-substantive-work session classes. ≥3 consecutive at top = the\n# 22-session stall pattern that surfaced as M-S171-1 (S148-S170, ~100K wasted main).\n#\n# Per CLAUDE.md hard rule + Phase 3.5 Hard Rule #2: every hook ships with companion\n# firing-test (scripts/hooks/firing-tests/idle-escape-detector-fire-test.sh).\n# Per UP-05 + L-S11-1: bash + POSIX tools only; no Skill tool calls.\n# Exit 0 ALWAYS (informational, not blocking).\nset -uo pipefail\ntrap 'exit 0' ERR\n\nPROJECT_DIR=\"${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}\"\nSID=\"${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}\"\nEVENT=\"${CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT:-UserPromptSubmit}\"\nmkdir -p \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\nCE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\"\nPLANS_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/session-plans/pending\"\nHOOK_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\nIDLE_LOG=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape.log\"\n\n# Per-hour-bucket idempotency marker per L-S108-1 (CLAUDE_SESSION_ID may be empty\n# under SessionStart on Windows → fallback to constant collides across sessions).\nBUCKET=\"$(date +%Y%m%d-%H 2>/dev/null)\"\n[ -z \"$BUCKET\" ] && BUCKET=\"unbucketed-$$\"\nMARKER=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-fired-${BUCKET}\"\nTS=\"$(date -Iseconds 2>/dev/null || date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')\"\n\n# Per-session 5-min cache (mirrors harness-health-self-scan.sh) to avoid re-firing\n# on every UserPromptSubmit within same session — perf budget on UserPromptSubmit\n# is <2s.\nCACHE=\"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-cache-${SID}\"\nif [ -f \"$CACHE\" ]; then\n  CACHE_MTIME=$(stat -c %Y \"$CACHE\" 2>/dev/null || stat -f %m \"$CACHE\" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\n  AGE=$(( $(date +%s) - CACHE_MTIME ))\n  if [ \"$AGE\" -lt 300 ]; then\n    echo \"[$TS] idle-escape-detector: CACHE-HIT age=${AGE}s session=$SID\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\" 2>/dev/null || true\n    exit 0\n  fi\nfi\n\n# Cleanup stale hour-bucket markers from prior buckets (L-S108-1 prevention).\nfor old_marker in \"$PROJECT_DIR/agent-workspace/memory\"/.idle-escape-fired-*; do\n  [ -f \"$old_marker\" ] || continue\n  case \"$old_marker\" in\n    *\".idle-escape-fired-${BUCKET}\") ;;\n    *) rm -f \"$old_marker\" 2>/dev/null || true ;;\n  esac\ndone\n\n# Bail gracefully if current-execution.md missing.\nif [ ! -f \"$CE\" ]; then\n  touch \"$MARKER\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  exit 0\nfi\n\nset +o pipefail\n\n# ============================================================================\n# Step 1: pull last 5 session-block ## S<N> header lines (newest-first since\n# current-execution.md prepends new sessions at top).\n# ============================================================================\nHEADERS=$(grep -m 5 -E '^## S[0-9]+[a-z]?[[:space:]]+—[[:space:]]+Phase' \"$CE\" 2>/dev/null)\nHEADER_COUNT=$(echo \"$HEADERS\" | grep -c '^## S' 2>/dev/null || echo 0)\n[[ \"$HEADER_COUNT\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || HEADER_COUNT=0\n\nif [ \"$HEADER_COUNT\" -lt 1 ]; then\n  touch \"$MARKER\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  echo \"session=$SID ts=$TS state=NO-HEADERS detail=cannot-parse-blocks\" > \"$CACHE\" 2>/dev/null || true\n  exit 0\nfi\n\n# ============================================================================\n# Step 2: count consecutive ROUTINE-IDLE / META-CADENCE among newest blocks.\n# Stop counting at first non-idle header.\n# ============================================================================\nCONSECUTIVE=0\nLATEST_LABEL=\"\"\nLATEST_SID=\"\"\nwhile IFS= read -r line; do\n  [ -z \"$line\" ] && continue\n  if [ -z \"$LATEST_LABEL\" ]; then\n    LATEST_SID=$(echo \"$line\" | sed -E 's/^## (S[0-9]+[a-z]?).*/\\1/')\n    if echo \"$line\" | grep -qE '— ROUTINE-IDLE'; then LATEST_LABEL=\"ROUTINE-IDLE\"\n    elif echo \"$line\" | grep -qE '— META-CADENCE'; then LATEST_LABEL=\"META-CADENCE\"\n    else LATEST_LABEL=\"ACTIVE\"\n    fi\n  fi\n  if echo \"$line\" | grep -qE '— (ROUTINE-IDLE|META-CADENCE)'; then\n    CONSECUTIVE=$((CONSECUTIVE + 1))\n  else\n    break\n  fi\ndone <<< \"$HEADERS\"\n\n# ============================================================================\n# Step 3: scan session-plans/pending/ for queued plans (informational boost —\n# idle while plans are queued = stronger escape signal).\n# ============================================================================\nPENDING_PLANS=0\nif [ -d \"$PLANS_DIR\" ]; then\n  PENDING_PLANS=$(find \"$PLANS_DIR\" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.md' -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')\n  [[ \"$PENDING_PLANS\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || PENDING_PLANS=0\nfi\n\n# ============================================================================\n# Step 4: severity classification.\n#   - GREEN: 0-2 consecutive idle\n#   - YELLOW: ≥3 consecutive idle, no pending plans\n#   - RED: ≥3 consecutive idle AND pending plans ≥1 (work queued + ignored)\n# Threshold ≥3 anchors to L-S171-1 / M-S171-1 doctrine.\n# ============================================================================\nSTATE=\"GREEN\"\nSEVERITY=\"LOW\"\nif [ \"$CONSECUTIVE\" -ge 3 ] && [ \"$PENDING_PLANS\" -ge 1 ]; AP-5 + Charter Principle 8 binding.\"\n\nif [ \"$EVENT\" = \"UserPromptSubmit\" ]; then\n  if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then\n    node -e \"process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'UserPromptSubmit',additionalContext:process.argv[1]}}))\" \"$REMINDER_BODY\" 2>/dev/null || \\\n      echo \"[phase-coherence] $REMINDER_BODY\" >&2\n  else\n    echo \"[phase-coherence] $REMINDER_BODY\" >&2\n  fi\nelif [ \"$EVENT\" = \"SessionStart\" ]; then\n  echo \"[phase-coherence] $REMINDER_BODY\" >&2\nelse\n  echo \"[phase-coherence] event=$EVENT $REMINDER_BODY\" >&2\nfi\n\ntouch \"$MARKER\" 2>/dev/null || true\nexit 0\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a1c9f9ae-c070-431c-be24-f4549c8781ac","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"e79835ac-886f-4624-8683-dee1aa8cb3e3","version":"2.1.124","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"ffe350c7-afa2-4761-b0c9-2a0fb22eff58","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01WTLAhPH5nvNgZP5KeKuZMT","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JGKvA6bVWDJZmfdxKn4Aay","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\scripts\\hooks\\firing-tests\\idle-escape-detector-fire-test.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Firing-test for idle-escape-detector.sh.\n# Phase 3.5 / S175 deliverable. Per Hard Rule #2 every hook ships with companion\n# firing-test that synthesizes a deliberate FAIL state + asserts hook detects it.\n#\n# 6 test cases:\n#   TC1 — current-execution.md missing → silent (graceful bail)\n#   TC2 — 1 ROUTINE-IDLE at top → silent (consecutive=1 < threshold 3)\n#   TC3 — 3 consecutive ROUTINE-IDLE → state=YELLOW (no pending plans)\n#   TC4 — 3 consecutive ROUTINE-IDLE + 2 pending plans → state=RED (severity=HIGH)\n#   TC5 — 5 ACTIVE blocks → silent (consecutive=0)\n#   TC6 — cache hit on second invocation within 5 min → CACHE-HIT log\n#\n# Per L-S174-1: when checking RED-state RC, use `RC=0; cmd || RC=$?` pattern\n# (this script doesn't set ERR-trap on EXIT but we follow the doctrine for any\n# rc-capture).\n\nset -uo pipefail\n\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" && pwd)\"\nHOOK=\"$SCRIPT_DIR/../idle-escape-detector.sh\"\n[ ! -f \"$HOOK\" ] && { echo \"FAIL: hook script not found at $HOOK\"; exit 1; }\n[ -x \"$HOOK\" ] || chmod +x \"$HOOK\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\nPASS=0\nFAIL=0\nTOTAL=0\n\nassert() {\n  local desc=\"$1\" cond=\"$2\"\n  TOTAL=$((TOTAL + 1))\n  if [ \"$cond\" = \"1\" ] || [ \"$cond\" = \"true\" ]; then\n    PASS=$((PASS + 1))\n    echo \"  [PASS] $desc\"\n  else\n    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))\n    echo \"  [FAIL] $desc\"\n  fi\n}\n\n# Use a fresh tempdir per test to isolate cache + markers.\nnew_tempdir() {\n  local d\n  d=$(mktemp -d -t idle-escape-test-XXXXXX 2>/dev/null || mktemp -d 2>/dev/null || echo \"/tmp/idle-escape-$$-${RANDOM}\")\n  mkdir -p \"$d/agent-workspace/memory\" \"$d/agent-workspace/session-plans/pending\" 2>/dev/null\n  echo \"$d\"\n}\n\n# Build a current-execution.md with N consecutive ROUTINE-IDLE blocks at top\n# followed by M ACTIVE blocks. SID counter starts at 200.\nbuild_ce() {\n  local out=\"$1\" idle_count=\"$2\" active_count=\"$3\"\n  : > \"$out\"\n  echo \"# Current Execution — Test fixture\" >> \"$out\"\n  echo \"\" >> \"$out\"\n  local sid=200\n  local i\n  for ((i=0; i<idle_count; i++)); do\n    echo \"## S${sid} — Phase 3 — ROUTINE-IDLE: synthesized idle block #${i} for fixture testing.\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"Body of routine idle session ${sid}.\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"---\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"\" >> \"$out\"\n    sid=$((sid - 1))\n  done\n  for ((i=0; i<active_count; i++)); do\n    echo \"## S${sid} — Phase 3.5 — FOCUSED_IMPL-DONE: synthesized active block.\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"Body of active session ${sid}.\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"---\" >> \"$out\"\n    echo \"\" >> \"$out\"\n    sid=$((sid - 1))\n  done\n}\n\n# === TC1: missing current-execution.md → silent (graceful bail) ===\necho \"=== TC1: missing current-execution.md ===\"\nTC1_DIR=$(new_tempdir)\nTC1_LOG=\"$TC1_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\nRC=0\nCLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TC1_DIR\" CLAUDE_SESSION_ID=\"tc1\" CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT=\"UserPromptSubmit\" \\\n  bash \"$HOOK\" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || RC=$?\nTC1_FIRED=0\n[ -f \"$TC1_LOG\" ] && grep -q \"ESCAPE-TRIGGER\" \"$TC1_LOG\" 2>/dev/null && TC1_FIRED=1\nassert \"TC1: hook exits 0 with missing CE file\" \"$([ \"$RC\" -eq 0 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC1: no escape-trigger fired (graceful bail)\" \"$([ \"$TC1_FIRED\" -eq 0 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nrm -rf \"$TC1_DIR\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# === TC2: 1 ROUTINE-IDLE → silent ===\necho \"=== TC2: 1 idle block (below threshold) ===\"\nTC2_DIR=$(new_tempdir)\nbuild_ce \"$TC2_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\" 1 4\nTC2_CACHE=\"$TC2_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-cache-tc2\"\nTC2_IDLE_LOG=\"$TC2_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape.log\"\nCLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TC2_DIR\" CLAUDE_SESSION_ID=\"tc2\" CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT=\"UserPromptSubmit\" \\\n  bash \"$HOOK\" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\nTC2_STATE=$(grep -oE 'state=[A-Z]+' \"$TC2_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/state=//')\nTC2_FIRED=0\n[ -f \"$TC2_IDLE_LOG\" ] && grep -q \"ESCAPE-TRIGGER\" \"$TC2_IDLE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null && TC2_FIRED=1\nassert \"TC2: state=GREEN (1 idle)\" \"$([ \"$TC2_STATE\" = \"GREEN\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC2: no escape-trigger fired\" \"$([ \"$TC2_FIRED\" -eq 0 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nrm -rf \"$TC2_DIR\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# === TC3: 3 consecutive ROUTINE-IDLE → state=YELLOW (no pending plans) ===\necho \"=== TC3: 3 idle blocks no pending plans (YELLOW) ===\"\nTC3_DIR=$(new_tempdir)\nbuild_ce \"$TC3_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\" 3 2\nTC3_CACHE=\"$TC3_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-cache-tc3\"\nTC3_IDLE_LOG=\"$TC3_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape.log\"\nCLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TC3_DIR\" CLAUDE_SESSION_ID=\"tc3\" CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT=\"UserPromptSubmit\" \\\n  bash \"$HOOK\" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\nTC3_STATE=$(grep -oE 'state=[A-Z]+' \"$TC3_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/state=//')\nTC3_CONS=$(grep -oE 'consecutive=[0-9]+' \"$TC3_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/consecutive=//')\nTC3_FIRED=0\n[ -f \"$TC3_IDLE_LOG\" ] && grep -q \"ESCAPE-TRIGGER\" \"$TC3_IDLE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null && TC3_FIRED=1\nassert \"TC3: state=YELLOW (3 idle, 0 plans)\" \"$([ \"$TC3_STATE\" = \"YELLOW\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC3: consecutive=3 detected\" \"$([ \"$TC3_CONS\" = \"3\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC3: escape-trigger fired\" \"$([ \"$TC3_FIRED\" -eq 1 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nrm -rf \"$TC3_DIR\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# === TC4: 3 idle + 2 pending plans → state=RED severity=HIGH ===\necho \"=== TC4: 3 idle blocks + 2 pending plans (RED HIGH) ===\"\nTC4_DIR=$(new_tempdir)\nbuild_ce \"$TC4_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\" 3 2\necho \"# plan a\" > \"$TC4_DIR/agent-workspace/session-plans/pending/plan-a.md\"\necho \"# plan b\" > \"$TC4_DIR/agent-workspace/session-plans/pending/plan-b.md\"\nTC4_CACHE=\"$TC4_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-cache-tc4\"\nTC4_IDLE_LOG=\"$TC4_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape.log\"\nCLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TC4_DIR\" CLAUDE_SESSION_ID=\"tc4\" CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT=\"UserPromptSubmit\" \\\n  bash \"$HOOK\" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\nTC4_STATE=$(grep -oE 'state=[A-Z]+' \"$TC4_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/state=//')\nTC4_SEV=$(grep -oE 'severity=[A-Z]+' \"$TC4_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/severity=//')\nTC4_PLANS=$(grep -oE 'pending_plans=[0-9]+' \"$TC4_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/pending_plans=//')\nTC4_FIRED=0\n[ -f \"$TC4_IDLE_LOG\" ] && grep -q \"ESCAPE-TRIGGER\" \"$TC4_IDLE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null && TC4_FIRED=1\nassert \"TC4: state=RED (3 idle + 2 plans)\" \"$([ \"$TC4_STATE\" = \"RED\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC4: severity=HIGH\" \"$([ \"$TC4_SEV\" = \"HIGH\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC4: pending_plans=2 detected\" \"$([ \"$TC4_PLANS\" = \"2\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC4: escape-trigger fired\" \"$([ \"$TC4_FIRED\" -eq 1 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nrm -rf \"$TC4_DIR\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# === TC5: 5 ACTIVE blocks → silent ===\necho \"=== TC5: 5 active blocks (no idle) ===\"\nTC5_DIR=$(new_tempdir)\nbuild_ce \"$TC5_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\" 0 5\nTC5_CACHE=\"$TC5_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-cache-tc5\"\nTC5_IDLE_LOG=\"$TC5_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape.log\"\nCLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TC5_DIR\" CLAUDE_SESSION_ID=\"tc5\" CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT=\"UserPromptSubmit\" \\\n  bash \"$HOOK\" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 || true\nTC5_STATE=$(grep -oE 'state=[A-Z]+' \"$TC5_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/state=//')\nTC5_CONS=$(grep -oE 'consecutive=[0-9]+' \"$TC5_CACHE\" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/consecutive=//')\nTC5_FIRED=0\n[ -f \"$TC5_IDLE_LOG\" ] && grep -q \"ESCAPE-TRIGGER\" \"$TC5_IDLE_LOG\" 2>/dev/null && TC5_FIRED=1\nassert \"TC5: state=GREEN (0 idle)\" \"$([ \"$TC5_STATE\" = \"GREEN\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC5: consecutive=0\" \"$([ \"$TC5_CONS\" = \"0\" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nassert \"TC5: no escape-trigger\" \"$([ \"$TC5_FIRED\" -eq 0 ] && echo 1 || echo 0)\"\nrm -rf \"$TC5_DIR\" 2>/dev/null || true\n\n# === TC6: cache-hit on second invocation within 5 min ===\necho \"=== TC6: cache-hit on 2nd invocation ===\"\nTC6_DIR=$(new_tempdir)\nbuild_ce \"$TC6_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/current-execution.md\" 3 2\nTC6_LOG=\"$TC6_DIR/agent-workspace/memory/.session-hooks.log\"\n# First fire — populates cache.\nCLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=\"$TC6_DIR\" CLAUDE_SESSION_ID=\"tc6\" CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT=\"UserPromptSubmit\" Threshold ≥3 anchors to the L-S171-1 doctrine — the exact pattern that escaped detection at S148-S170.\n\n**Severity matrix**:\n\n| consecutive | pending_plans | state  | severity |\n|-------------|---------------|--------|----------|\n| 0-2         | any           | GREEN  | LOW      |\n| ≥3          | 0             | YELLOW | MEDIUM   |\n| ≥3          | ≥1            | RED    | HIGH     |\n\nThe pending-plans boost reflects the M-S171-1 surface: 12 plans queued while idle = work-available-but-ignored = stronger escape signal.\n\n**Idempotency layers**:\n\n- **Hour-bucket marker** (`agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-fired-YYYYMMDD-HH`) — suppresses duplicate system-reminder emission within same hour bucket. SessionStart emits via stderr (visible in `.session-hooks.log`).\n\n### Hook 2: phase-status-coherence.sh\n\n**Three checks** (each contributes to severity aggregation):\n\n| Check | Detection | Severity contribution |\n|-------|-----------|----------------------|\n| (A) Phase mismatch | latest `## S<N> — Phase X` header phase X NOT IN project.md IN PROGRESS rows | RED HIGH |\n| (B) Stale project.md | ≥3 NEW ADRs in `decisions/` newer than `project.md` mtime by >2h AND `current-execution.md` newer than project.md by >24h | YELLOW MEDIUM |\n| (C) No active phase | project.md Phase Goals Tracker has zero IN PROGRESS rows while sessions still progressing | YELLOW MEDIUM |\n\nSeverity aggregates: any (A) hit → RED. if UserPromptSubmit cache-hit ratio\n    >50% within 5-min windows, increase TTL to reduce overhead.\ntags:\n  - \"phase-3.5\"\n  - \"harness\"\n  - \"M-S171-1\"\n  - \"prevention\"\n  - \"idle-escape\"\n  - \"phase-coherence\"\n  - \"userpromptsubmit-hook\"\n  - \"firing-test-shipped\"\n  - \"production-firing-evidence\"\n---\n\n# Decision 037 — M-S171-1 Prevention Hooks\n\n## Context\n\nS171 surfaced M-S171-1: 22 consecutive ROUTINE-IDLE / META-CADENCE sessions S148-S170 with zero substantive progress. The post-S147 idle-loop heuristic was too narrow — it checked user_prompt mtime + drift D1 + sync-grilling cadence + in-flight dispatch but missed:\n\n1. **session-plans/pending/** — 12 plans queued (008-S45 Track G/H/I + 009-S48 Phase 2.5 HH-A..HH-H + 009-S51 Track J/K + 010-S50 Phase 3.5)\n2. **project.md Phase vs current-execution.md Phase** — silent advance from \"Phase 2.5 IN PROGRESS / Phase 3 PAUSED\" (project.md S48d) to \"Phase 3\" (current-execution.md S148+) without `verify_phase_before_next_phase` audit\n\nUser signal 2026-05-07: \"sao lại dừng rồi, không chạy autonomous nữa? lỗi harness à?\" surfaced the gap. ~100K wasted main accumulated across 22 idle/cadence sessions before user push detected the stall.\n\nS172 audit reconciliation closed the immediate state mismatch. M-S171-1 codified 3 prevention rules:\n\n1. `idle-escape-detector.sh` SessionStart hook scanning plans/pending vs current-execution active-track\n2. `phase-status-coherence.sh` SessionStart hook diffing project.md vs current-execution Phase claim\n3. Escape doctrine: ≥3 consecutive ROUTINE-IDLE → mandate phase-audit subagent dispatch OR Q&A escalation, never silent 4th idle\n\nS173 closed Phase 3.5 T5/T6/T8 charter user-gate. S174 closed Phase 2.5 HH-G portability residue per Q4=A user-pick. S175 (this turn) executes M-S171-1 prevention rules per S174 checkpoint PRIORITY 1.\n\n## Analysis\n\n### Hook 1: idle-escape-detector.sh\n\n**Detection signal**: count consecutive `ROUTINE-IDLE` or `META-CADENCE` blocks at the top (newest) of `current-execution.md`. Threshold ≥3 anchors to the L-S171-1 doctrine — the exact pattern that escaped detection at S148-S170.\n\n**Severity matrix**:\n\n| consecutive | pending_plans | state  | severity |\n|-------------|---------------|--------|----------|\n| 0-2         | any           | GREEN  | LOW      |\n| ≥3          | 0             | YELLOW | MEDIUM   |\n| ≥3          | ≥1            | RED    | HIGH     |\n\nThe pending-plans boost reflects the M-S171-1 surface: 12 plans queued while idle = work-available-but-ignored = stronger escape signal.\n\n**Idempotency layers**:\n\n- **Hour-bucket marker** (`agent-workspace/memory/.idle-escape-fired-YYYYMMDD-HH`) — suppresses duplicate system-reminder emission within same hour bucket. Cleanup loop sweeps stale buckets per L-S108-1 (M-S108-1 sister-bug fix doctrine).\n- **5-min same-session cache** (`.idle-escape-cache-${SID}`) — perf budget on UserPromptSubmit; mirrors harness-health-self-scan.sh TTL.\n\n**Emit channel**: UserPromptSubmit emits via `node -e ... hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` JSON contract → injects system-reminder into LLM context. SessionStart emits via stderr (visible in `.session-hooks.log`).\n\n### Hook 2: phase-status-coherence.sh\n\n**Three checks** (each contributes to severity aggregation):\n\n| Check | Detection | Severity contribution |\n|-------|-----------|----------------------|\n| (A) Phase mismatch | latest `## S<N> — Phase X` header phase X NOT IN project.md IN PROGRESS rows | RED HIGH |\n| (B) Stale project.md | ≥3 NEW ADRs in `decisions/` newer than `project.md` mtime by >2h AND `current-execution.md` newer than project.md by >24h | YELLOW MEDIUM |\n| (C) No active phase | project.md Phase Goals Tracker has zero IN PROGRESS rows while sessions still progressing | YELLOW MEDIUM |\n\nSeverity aggregates: any (A) hit → RED. (B) or (C) without (A) → YELLOW. None → GREEN.\n\n**Differentiation from existing HH-12** (`harness-health-self-scan.sh`): HH-12 only checks (A) at Stop + SessionStart cadence with broader 5-min cache. phase-status-coherence runs at UserPromptSubmit (per-prompt) AND adds checks (B) and (C). The two hooks are defense-in-depth — different cache TTLs surface different drift latencies.\n\n### Companion firing-tests\n\nPer Phase 3.5 Hard Rule #2 (every hook ships with companion firing-test). the new phase-status-coherence is additive (UserPromptSubmit cadence catches faster).\n- T8 charter cool-down (≥2026-05-09) — orthogonal; unchanged.\n- M-S173-1 deny-lift gap — orthogonal; unchanged.\n\n## Why (Reasons)\n\n1. **M-S171-1 prevention rules verbatim**: The mistake-log entry codified two named hooks. NEW hooks must continue the discipline.\n5. **harness_priority_one user doctrine**: harness/system improvement always > product work. M-S171-1 prevention = pure harness; closes a known gap that cost ~100K wasted main.\n6. **Counter-factual evidence**: had these hooks been wired at S148, the M-S171-1 stall converts to a 1-session reconcile (22-session × 100K main saved).\n\n## Risks & Mitigations\n\n| Risk | Likelihood | Mitigation |\n|---|---|---|\n| False-positive: legitimate 3-cadence cluster (e.g., post-/clear catch-up sessions) | medium | Hour-bucket idempotency suppresses repeat alerts within same hour; pending_plans=0 keeps state=YELLOW (advisory) not RED |\n| Pattern drift: future session blocks use new ROUTINE-* labels not matched by regex | low | Regex anchored to `— ROUTINE-IDLE\\|— META-CADENCE`; new labels would silently be classified ACTIVE — fail-safe direction |\n| Perf budget on UserPromptSubmit: 2 hooks × ~150ms each = 300ms additional latency per prompt | low | 5-min same-session cache → only first prompt of each 5-min window pays full cost; firing-test passes 15/15 + 16/16 |\n| Empty `node` binary in stripped environments | low | Fallback to stderr emission preserves observability without JSON injection |\n\n## Open Questions\n\n(none — closed via empirical-firing evidence)\n\nIf these hooks accumulate >5 false-positives in 30 sessions, threshold tuning candidate:\n\n- consecutive threshold: 3 → 4 (looser)\n- severity boost rule: pending_plans ≥1 → ≥2 (require multiple plans to RED)\n\nDefer such tuning to post-S180 calibration pass with empirical data.\n\n## Acceptance Record\n\n- **2026-05-07 S171**: M-S171-1 surfaced;
